entries.zh: 条序：事物按数目排列的次序。
entries.en: order of things, as by number; sequence, arrangement

entries.zh: 品从：身分等第、品级（如婚姻、军伍等各等身分）。
entries.en: rank or estate (e.g. of marriage, of arms); grade and precedence

entries.zh: 头列：任何事物的第一列、首位。
entries.en: the first row or rank of anything; first place

entries.zh: 朝班：群臣朝见君王时按品级排列的班次。
entries.en: the ranks in which courtiers do reverence to the King; court order of precedence

entries.zh: 人品：人的品级、等第（别其先后高下）。
entries.en: rank or grade of persons; standing (first and last)
entries.notes: 西语“primero y postrero”指等第之先后，“人品”此处取品级义，非品格义。

entries.zh: 序齿：按年龄长幼排定先后次序。
entries.en: precedence by age; ordering from eldest to youngest
entries.notes: 西语只言“先与后”，长幼之义据汉字“序齿”定。

entries.zh: 序：排定次序；安排各人分内应得之位。
entries.en: to order, to arrange; to assign each his due place
to arrange, to set in order
entries.notes: 第二字原件“辦/辨”难定，据“张办”（张罗料理）义定夺。

entries.zh: 运用：调度、支配，使各就其序。
entries.en: to dispose, deploy, or apply; to set in order
entries.notes: “运用”与“poner por orden”仅部分对应，取其调度安排义。

entries.zh: 会规：善会、团体的规章；订立或整饬条例（如善会、民团之例）。
entries.en: statutes, ordinances (e.g. of confraternities, of the militia); to regulate, to correct
entries.notes: M栏混入西语“ordenanças ut de cofradias, de la milicia”，“会规”义由之补足。

entries.zh: 职管：依次安排职司，逐一管辖。
entries.en: to order or manage one after another; to assign duties in sequence
entries.notes: 西语“uno tras otro”与“职管”对应较松，取依次安排职司义。
汉字与M栏第二音节均有疑（seng/leng）；若作“乳”音，则与“挤奶”义合。

entries.en: ordinary, usual; commonly, as a rule
entries.notes: M栏以冒号另列“捷”一读，即下条“频繁”义。
首字原件“疾/捷”难定；“捷”有频繁义，与“muchas vezes”相合。
原件末字母c/g难辨；“数”取“频数、屡次”义，与“ordinariamente”合。
